hotspots.title: House GOP Impeachment Push Against Pete Hegseth
hotspots.blurb: House Republicans voted to block a Democratic attempt to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, referring the resolution to the Judiciary Committee instead. The vote ignited a wave of triumphant rhetoric from Donald Trump and MAGA allies while infuriating congressional Democrats.
hotspots.affect: The high-stakes floor vote provided a flashpoint for intense partisan polarization, combining MAGA celebration with fierce Democratic accusations of GOP complicity.

hotspots.title: Pope Leo XIV & Javier Milei Dueling Visions Clash
hotspots.blurb: Pope Leo XIV wrapped up his high-profile trip to Argentina with explicit social warnings and visits to low-income communities, while President Javier Milei maintained a tense distance. The event triggered scandal over exclusive VIP tent access for wealthy donors and accusations of commercializing the papal visit.
hotspots.affect: The contrast between the Pope's moral crusade against poverty and Milei's libertarian austerity unleashed deep ideological contention and accusations of corruption.

hotspots.title: Viktor Orbán's Brother Arrested in Human Smuggling Probe
hotspots.blurb: Hungarian authorities arrested Áron Orbán, the brother of Prime Minister Viktor Orbán, in connection with an illegal human trafficking and tax fraud investigation. Opposition leader Péter Magyar capitalized on the arrest to demand full transparency, while pro-government figures reacted with shock.
hotspots.affect: The direct criminal implication of the Prime Minister's family member created explosive affective charge around government corruption and legal hypocrisy.

hotspots.title: Italy Mass School Bomb Threats & Meloni Summit
hotspots.blurb: Thousands of Italian schools faced coordinated hoax bomb threats, causing mass evacuations and prompting Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni to call an emergency leader summit. Officials suspect a deliberate strategy to spread panic, with speculation pointing toward foreign hybrid warfare tactics.
hotspots.affect: The threat targeting thousands of children produced nationwide security anxiety, immediate emergency mobilization, and hostile political finger-pointing.

hotspots.title: Santiago Abascal & David Broncano TV Clash
hotspots.blurb: Vox leader Santiago Abascal abruptly cancelled a podcast interview with Jordi Wild, blaming public broadcaster RTVE and host David Broncano for censoring his previous appearance. The move backfired into media mockery and publicly exposed internal friction within Vox leadership.
hotspots.affect: The feud combines right-wing anti-media grievance with embarrassing public disputes that triggered internal mockery from fellow party leaders.
